h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Avadi

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Avadi

c: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Avadi for defence and government residential quarters, schools, colleges, housing board colonies and the parks run by the Avadi City Municipal Corporation. We manufacture our Fun Fitness machines at our factory in Vasai, about 1,040 km away, and bring them to the western edge of Chennai by road for installation.

Drainage is the first thing to look at in Avadi. The northeast monsoon from October to December brings most of the year's rain in a few weeks, and flat open grounds in this part of Chennai can stay waterlogged. An open gym on low ground will be unusable just when people want to come back after the rains. Raise the base a little, slope it, and keep the machines away from the lowest corner of the plot. The rest of the year is hot and humid, so galvanised frames, roto-moulded seats and some shade are worth planning for.

items.q: Can you supply a government or defence colony in Avadi?
items.a: Yes. Send us the park layout and photos. We prepare a layout drawing and quote, manufacture after approval and install with our team or a dealer in Tamil Nadu.

items.q: What surface works best under outdoor gym machines in a rainy area?
items.a: A firm, raised base with good drainage. Rubber flooring around the machines also helps footing and dries faster than soil after heavy rain. We supply rubber flooring if you need it.
